prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for specific kinds of change is still thin, as only one test has been conducted per category.
No clear effect was seen for any kind of change tested so far, as no tests produced a significant win.
Predictions were systematically too high across all round 1 tests compared to measured outcomes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Custom Pet Studio: Redesign the friend picker into a stage layout featuring a prominent animated pet preview canvas with visual companion trait badges. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and median time of 89s, plus users report custom pet generation visual issues.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick Tutorial: Introduce a new desktop guide screen before final onboarding completion that visually explains how to move, hide, and talk to the pet on the desktop. (why: Support received multiple tickets from confused users after setup asking how to control, hide, or interact with their pet.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Story Scroll Path Selector: Transform the path selection into a story scroll layout with interactive cards comparing quick adoption versus custom creation. (why: Choose path screen takes a mean time of 514s and drops 23.8% of users on their very first decision.)
3: [home, redesign] Interactive Mascot Wait Stage: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight layout featuring an animated mini mascot playing on screen while pet files compile. (why: The waiting step has an extreme mean time of 2336s (median 201s) causing dropoff before finishing onboarding.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync Reassurance Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that account creation backs up and saves your pet state safely across restarts. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Requirements Guide: Add clear photo guidelines and tip cards on photo upload screen showing well-lit face examples to ensure high quality custom generation. (why: Support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step dropoff is 39.1%.)
6: [home, wait_info] Background Creation Progress Bar: Display a structured step-by-step loading progress indicator detailing active tasks like asset loading, animation rigging, and desktop placement. (why: The waiting screen long load times cause users to think the app stalled or frozen.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Alert: Enable desktop notification switch during generation so users can safely minimize the desktop window while waiting. (why: Generation takes median 201s / mean 2336s, causing drop-off if users wait on active focus.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Instant Adoption Path Highlights: Revise path selection titles and button labels to highlight speed differences between 'Instant Companion (10 secs)' and 'Custom AI Pet (2 mins)'. (why: Users spend a mean time of 514s on path selection, indicating confusion over choices and time expectations.)
